name: Stratum Mid-Level Pressed Trouser
description: Charcoal poly-wool blend slacks with a permanent-press finish that survives a full transit commute without creasing. Side seams have hidden snap channels for standard leg prosthetics up to 40mm diameter. Sold in six inseam lengths, all identical cuts — conformity is the point.
functionality: Permanent-press finish, aug-compatible side seams, moisture-wicking inner lining.
what_it_says: You dress like everyone else on your floor, which is exactly what your supervisor wants.
story_hooks: A pair found in a lost-and-found bin has an access badge sewn into the waistband — still active.
The permanent-press chemical coating slowly releases a mild stress-suppressant absorbed through the skin; no one at Stratum is advertising this.
